nominal_timing_note: Source-confirmed target convention, not native timestamp channel
corner_entry: First measured pose within original gate center Y band, east of exit plane and west of start X plus original robot disk radius
corner_passage: Original spatial_turn_gate crossing plus next observation; completion at that next observation application; separately require original two-interval actual-left-motion evidence
trimdoor5_passage: After entering corner, entire robot disk west of original TrimDoor5 minimum world X, center inside original corridor band
precontact: Both FRESH observation and application strictly before first nonfloor contact
inspection_pair: First precontact FRESH observation inside corner-entry region; fallback last precontact pair explicitly outside corner if entry never observed
spatial_comparison: Precontact observation bins of world Y on approach and world X within original corridor Y band; no C-index matching
secondary_comparison: Previous cart1.2 versus no-cart1.0 changes speed and cart; contextual only, no causal cart claim
